findings.claim: is structurally identical to the retro experiment discipline ... The Primer endorses the retro shape from the org-design side
findings.failure_mode: Attributes an endorsement of retrospectives to the Primer. The Primer frames Elevating Katas as thoughtful experiments and elevation as incremental; it says nothing about retros.

findings.claim: OT's strategic-AI stance gives the team a productive frame: the team is becoming the monitoring-and-elevation layer that the AI agents need, rather than being replaced by them.
findings.failure_mode: The Primer predicts monitoring will be an important human responsibility; it makes no claim that teams will not be replaced, and elsewhere says 'Spin up another 10,000 agents'.
findings.evidence: Deep 168 (p. 20): 'We predict that monitoring will become an important responsibility for human workers.' Deep 170 (p. 21): 'The small number of existing front-end designers and developers joining the new CAPS-3 teams will be trained in agent monitoring'. Deep 160: 'Spin up another 10,000 agents.'
findings.fix: correct: OT's strategic-AI stance gives the team a frame: the Primer predicts monitoring AI agents becomes an important human responsibility, and in its pet-supply example the existing specialists take that role (pp. 20-21).

findings.claim: a precise request — a structural experiment to pilot end-to-end CAPS-2 coverage for one capability area
findings.failure_mode: Wrong archetype code: the Primer defines CAPS-2 as multi-skilled yet incomplete; end-to-end at the capability level is CAPS-3, which the example itself names two paragraphs earlier as the work-demanded archetype.

findings.fix: correct: a structural experiment to pilot end-to-end CAPS-3 coverage for one capability area

findings.claim: Open Kanban's Holistic-Systemic value and the Goldratt borrowed-through ... are invoked by OT at the theoretical level but those works are not cited in the Primer's bibliography
findings.failure_mode: The Primer does not invoke Open Kanban or Goldratt, and it has no bibliography. The distillation brought in Open Kanban; the Primer did not.
findings.evidence: No 'Kanban' or 'Goldratt' in converted source 1-1582 (grep) or in deep 1-299. Open Kanban's Deming/Goldratt line is open-kanban-deep 52.
findings.fix: correct: The distillation pairs the Primer with Open Kanban's Holistic-Systemic value (which borrows 'no single part of a system can ever bring overall improvement' from Deming and Goldratt); the Primer itself cites neither. The Primer's own borrowed-through references are Toyota (kata, p. 19), Scrum's Definition of Done (p. 6), systems thinking (p. 16), and the framework list on p. 22.

findings.claim: The archetype axis descriptions (TASKS-1/2, CAPS-2/3) are `[V]` in the deep ref (pp. 5–7)
findings.failure_mode: Mis-cited: pp. 6-7 carry the level descriptions, not the archetype codes. TASKS-1 and CAPS-2 appear in the p. 5 [V] sentence, TASKS-2 on p. 16, CAPS-3 only in the p. 21 pet-supply example. The note also claims the p. 4 and p. 16 [V] quotes are carried, but lines 12, 24 carry the p. 4 quote unmarked.
findings.evidence: Deep 29-49 (pp. 6-7 level descriptions), 57 (p. 5), 130 (p. 16), 170 (p. 21).
findings.fix: correct: The archetype codes come from the deep ref's [V] passages on p. 5 (CAPS-2, TASKS-1), p. 16 (TASKS-2) and p. 21 (CAPS-3); the axis levels are [V, AE] on pp. 6-7.

notes: This distillation follows the template more closely than the AAR and decision-making ones (has What to Look For, When to Use, and a three-part Citation block) but has no blockquoted [V] passages. Seven verbatim quotations carry no [V] marker (D001, D002, D004, D005, D006, D007, D011) while others in the same file do, so marker discipline is inconsistent. The Borrowed-through gaps paragraph (D017-D019) describes borrowings the Primer does not make and omits the ones it does. Cross-source claims checked: Open Kanban quote correct (open-kanban-deep 52); LS 15% Solutions and What/So What/Now What present; OPL Retrospectives and Design of Experiments present; FLO engagement-equity tracking matrix present (flo-facilitation-guide-deep 245); SSDL archetype names correct.
